neighbours.label: negation ('n't', 'not') describing someone failing to respond the way you hoped (doesn't call you back, don't smile back, don't get their way): disappointed social expectation, not negation in general
fire: It stings a little when your best friend doesn't answer your messages.
Some people get offended when strangers don't return their greeting.
Teenagers often sulk when their parents don't listen to them.
You can feel rejected when your crush doesn't notice you at the party.
My sister gets upset when her friends don't invite her along.
It hurts when your grandchildren don't visit for months.
Toddlers throw tantrums when they don't get the toy they want.
He felt ignored because his colleagues didn't thank him for the help.
quiet: It is normal when a new phone doesn't charge fully the first time.
Some plants get damaged when their roots don't drain well.
Teenagers often sleep late when their alarms don't go off.
You can lose points when your answer doesn't show the working.
My sister gets wet when the bus shelter doesn't keep the rain out.
It helps when the kettle doesn't take long to boil.
Toddlers tire quickly when the walk doesn't have any shade.
He felt cold because the heating didn't work in the morning.
